say:0:1013821001:0.text: The dark magic still hasn't been lifted, Magister... I can't use my power!
say:0:1013821001:0.source_cn: 主人，黑魔法还未解除……无法使用力量！
say:0:1013821001:0.male: The dark magic still hasn't been lifted, Magister... I can't use my power!
say:0:1013821001:0.female: The dark magic still hasn't been lifted, Magister... I can't use my power!

say:1:1013821002:0.text: What's this? Your little blows aren't even doing anything.
say:1:1013821002:0.source_cn: 黑魔法的效果吗？不堪一击。

say:2:1013821003:0.text: Berial, seeing your disgusting face again has ruined my day.
say:2:1013821003:0.source_cn: 居然又见到了你这张脸，贝利尔。我心情都变差了。
